This violates the premise-verification gate even though the repeat-check mutation results remain useful.
result.catch: V06 establishes a narrow textual-search result, not the broader behavioral claim made in §2.3. Its positive control validates that the search can find direct calls, not that its scope covers the render path.
result.proposed_fix: Replace §2.3's opening with: “V06 found no direct time.Now/time.Since calls in non-test files matching host/workbench/*.go or host/daemon/workbench*.go. This is not a transitive audit of clock dependence. We retain the 2 s delay because the measured MS4/MT4 comparison shows that this test detects the injected delayed variation only with the delay present; it does not prove independence from all possible time-dependent behavior.” Narrow V06's stated conclusion accordingly.

result.strongest_objection: Gate 1 failure: the doc's most load-bearing config premise is asserted, not verified. §2.2 states 'The helper's in-process daemons mirror the capture script's serve flags (capture_marketing.sh:116–118)' — the premise that makes item (1) check 'exactly the pages captured' — yet V04's recorded output shows only line 116 ('serve --db … --workbench-still'). If the serve invocation continues on 117–118 with any flag the helper does not mirror, the committed test can pass on still pages that differ from what capture_marketing.sh actually captures, defeating the row's stated purpose. The same gap hits §2.1's headline decision: 'the drill FATALs without both pins (marketing_chrome_test.go:69–71)' appears in no V row — V03's observed column lists 52/54, 73, 122, 125–126, 136, 155, 159, 245 and never 69–71, and the FATAL path was never exercised (V09 hits the WORLD_CHROME skip first), so FATAL-vs-SKIP there is unverified. Likewise §1's characterization of the iter305 probe ('only t.LogFs … lines 249–250', 'mints its own store') is appealed to iteration-315 judge NB4 rather than observed in this log. Under a doc whose own standard is that every behavioral claim carries a V row, these are unverified premises.
